name: Municipal Council Palwal
populationApprox: 2,32,301 (Haryana ULB key figures; reference year not stated)
description: Civic archive for the 31 wards of Municipal Council Palwal, the urban local body for the Palwal district headquarters in southern NCR. The Kundli-Manesar-Palwal Expressway links Palwal to Manesar and intersects the Sohna-Palwal corridor on NH 919.
